research_metadata.title: Perth, WA Boutique Business Advisory Firms - Consolidated Research
research_metadata.research_methodology: 5-angle deep research with web search, website verification, and leadership verification
research_metadata.confidence_threshold: All companies have verified live websites and documented leadership/positioning

automotive_dealership.analysis: Perth, WA lacks a robust market of boutique, independently-positioned automotive dealership advisory firms. No dedicated boutique automotive dealership advisory firms operate exclusively in Perth - the market is dominated by national firms (BDO, Kelly+Partners). Only 6 firms meet some advisory criteria, with BDO Perth being the only firm with documented automotive dealership specialization (national firm). Other firms are general business advisors serving multiple industries including automotive.

construction_contracting.analysis: Perth has a robust market of 16 verified boutique construction business advisory firms, exceeding the 15-20 target. Strong concentration of construction-specialist business coaches (6 firms) with explicit focus on systemization, delegation, and owner disengagement. High-confidence opportunities with named decision-makers and live contact information.
best_targets: ACS Consulting (0.95 confidence - systems optimization for 10-150 person firms)
Business Success Educators (0.90 confidence - construction coaching specialist)
Builders Business Blackbelt (0.90 confidence - Australia's largest builders coach)

combined_market_insights.adapt_icp_alignment: Both sectors show clear owner-led SME advisory positioning. Construction sector is significantly more mature in boutique advisory market than automotive sector.
combined_market_insights.enrichment_potential: High - 64% of verified companies have named leadership accessible for decision-maker enrichment

market_gap_analysis.summary: Perth, WA has a significant market gap in boutique automotive dealership advisory services. No independently-positioned boutique advisors specializing exclusively in automotive dealer advisory exist in the market.
reasons: Large dealership groups (John Hughes, Gardner Autos) appear internally capable
National firms (BDO, Kelly+Partners) monopolize automotive advisory market
Local business advisors serve automotive clients but lack dealer-specific positioning
No independent 'owner-led automotive consultant' model found in Perth market
opportunities: Prestige Partners - founder-led independent with SME advisory focus
Brentnalls WA - SME advisory with succession planning services
